name: Suley's Store
tagline: Roblox kits that are ready for your game.
subtitle: Systems, UI and maps with full source code. You buy on Discord and get the kit in minutes.

perks.title: Full source code
perks.text: Every script is readable and commented, so you can change anything.

perks.title: Free updates
perks.text: Fixes and new features are posted in the Discord at no extra cost.

perks.title: Setup guide
perks.text: Step-by-step instructions get each kit running in Studio.

perks.title: Help on Discord
perks.text: If you get stuck, ask me and I'll help you set it up.

products.name: Football Engine
products.short: Full football gameplay: ball physics, tackles, keepers and matches.
products.description: Everything you need to launch a football game. Server-authoritative ball physics, tackling, shooting with power and curve, goalkeeper AI and a complete match flow with timers and scoring.

products.name: Combat Framework
products.short: Hitboxes, combos, blocking and stuns — smooth and exploit-safe.
products.description: A modular melee combat system with raycast hitboxes, combo chains, blocking, parrying and stun states. Hook in your own animations and VFX in minutes.

products.name: Glass UI Kit
products.short: 40+ clean, animated UI components with a frosted-glass look.
products.description: A polished UI library for Roblox: shop menus, inventories, settings, notifications, buttons and more. Fully tweened, scales to every device.

products.name: Simulator Starter
products.short: Pets, eggs, rebirths and saving — the full simulator loop.
products.description: Start your simulator with the core loop already done: clicking, currencies, pets with eggs and rarities, rebirths and safe DataStore saving.

products.name: Lobby & Matchmaking
products.short: Queues, parties and teleports into reserved servers.
products.description: A drop-in lobby with party invites, queue pads, skill-free or ranked matchmaking and safe teleports into reserved servers.

products.name: Tycoon Kit
products.short: Plots, droppers, buttons and upgrades with saving.
products.description: A clean, data-driven tycoon base. Claim plots, buy buttons, run droppers and upgrades — all saved between sessions.

products.name: Stadium Map Pack
products.short: Three optimised, low-poly stadiums ready for matches.
products.description: Three stylised stadiums built for performance, with spawn points, goals and camera spots already set up.

products.name: Admin Suite
products.short: Commands, bans, logs and a slick admin panel.
products.description: A lightweight admin system with a command bar, rank permissions, timed bans and a searchable log panel.

faq.q: How do I buy a kit?
faq.a: There's no checkout on this site. Join the Discord server and open a ticket, or DM me directly. Tell me which kit you want, pay, and you get it delivered right there.
Robux, PayPal and gift cards are accepted. Ask in Discord if you want to use something else.
Yes. Every kit comes with free updates — they're posted in the Discord server.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to script?
faq.a: No. Every kit ships with a setup guide. If you get stuck, ask in Discord and I'll help.

faq.q: Can I resell or leak kits?
faq.a: No. You can use kits in your own games, but reselling or sharing the files isn't allowed.
Because kits are digital files, sales are final once delivered. If something doesn't work, I'll fix it.
